title: Medical scene safety and first helper role
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for a safe first response before touching an injured person. It is designed for offline emergencies and does not replace professional care.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: fire, traffic, electricity, gas smell, violence, unstable buildings, or more casualties.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: fire, traffic, electricity, gas smell, violence, unstable buildings, or more casualties

title: Unconscious person breathing watch
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for watching breathing and protecting the person until help arrives.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: not breathing normally, noisy gasping, blue lips, vomiting, seizure, or injury from a fall.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: not breathing normally, noisy gasping, blue lips, vomiting, seizure, or injury from a fall
